note: Proposals, not content. Every one of these is a reading — an argument I would make, offered so the bench opens on an edit rather than a blank field. Reject freely; a rejected draft costs nothing and a bad claim accepted costs the corpus its credibility. Confidence values are my honest estimate of defensibility, not enthusiasm.

drafts.claim: The drifting swordsman who sells his services to both sides of a feud and profits from the arrangement.

drafts.b: once upon a time in the west
drafts.claim: Genre turned elegiac: faces held in extreme close-up against emptied landscape while the plot stalls.
A man builds a sealed environment in which to keep reconstructing a woman he has already lost.
Time travel as the mechanics of memory; the traveller keeps returning to one image of one woman.
Courtship conducted as surveillance, the neighbour's apartment framed and watched from a fixed vantage.
Two strangers adjacent in a loud city, the film built from near-misses at counters and in lobbies.

drafts.b: portrait of a lady on fire
drafts.claim: A relationship narrated from inside its own ending, so every scene is already a memory of itself.
The nocturnal city shot on distorting wide angles until neon and rain become the only weather.
The parent-child bond as unfinished business, staged in held domestic interiors that outlast the scene.
Martial skill filmed as inherited craft and school lineage rather than as spectacle.
Two 1950s films arriving separately at the aging man made irrelevant by the postwar city he built.
The classical ghost tale staged against painted skies, the supernatural rendered as theatre rather than effect.

drafts.b: portrait of a lady on fire
drafts.claim: A woman's life told through the men who transact over her, answered by a film where the looking is hers.
A bounded zone that reorganises whoever enters it until leaving stops being the point.
Renunciation as the climax: the decision against desire, filmed from a polite distance.
A family dismantled by the exercise of power, the landscape indifferent and enormous behind it.
The apparent protagonist killed mid-film, leaving the audience without a guide in a hostile interior.
The creature withheld from frame, a small crew picked off inside a vessel they cannot leave.

drafts.a: close encounters of the third kind
drafts.claim: First contact as awe answered by first contact as grief; the light show replaced by the problem of translation.
The assembled squad fortifying a fixed position against a numberless assault, introduced one skill at a time.
The created woman built to be tested by her maker, and the test becoming the film's whole architecture.
The interview as central form: a person questioning a machine to decide whether it is one.
A crew undone by proximity to the sublime object they were sent to reach, mediated by the ship's own mind.
The bureaucratic city as a single machine, with the clerk crushed somewhere inside its ductwork.
The state as choreographer, bodies moved in designed formation through architecture built to dwarf them.
Competing self-serving accounts of one event, the film refusing to arbitrate between the notebooks.
A man designing a space in which to keep meeting the dead woman he is responsible for.

drafts.b: once upon a time in the west
drafts.claim: The horizon held until a figure resolves out of it; arrival filmed as a test of the audience's patience.
Armies as blocks of pure colour moved across a landscape that registers no opinion about them.
Memory assembled as essay, with voice and image deliberately out of step so neither can be trusted alone.
Craft practised inside historical violence, the maker's discipline set against a countryside being burned.
A film that changes genre at its midpoint, abandoning the room it established for the city underneath.
Confinement filmed as architecture: the building or the pit becomes the antagonist and the trap.
Grief treated as a physical quantity that survives distance, and the reunion staged as an impossible room.
The man circling one remembered scene until he walks into it and completes his own death.

drafts.a: star wars episode v the empire strikes back
drafts.claim: The retreat across hostile terrain with the party split, told partly from its least powerful members.
